subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067 on current main, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or close that PR only after a narrower replacement fixes this issue?
rationale: The issue is a valid bug with a source-level current-main gap, but an open same-author PR already uses closing syntax and is conflicting/proof-gated, so a duplicate automated fix lane would race the unresolved branch decision.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can keep the active-run recovery intent while using current UI/Gateway session helpers and requiring live Dashboard proof.

options.title: Ask for contributor rebase and proof
options.body: The original contributor can update the linked branch against current main and add redacted tab-switch/reconnect proof before another review.

options.title: Close the branch after another fix lands
options.body: If a narrower proof-positive PR becomes the safe fix path, close the stale linked PR and then close this issue when the replacement is merged.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can keep the active-run recovery intent while using current UI/Gateway session helpers and requiring live Dashboard proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best current routing owner from recent current-main Dashboard/Gateway history and the linked branch requires a maintainer choice rather than a blind duplicate fix.
